entry.title: Eight GPUs, Two Generations: Benchmarking Open LLMs for an Astronomy Institute
entry.summary: We measured open-weight language models on a mixed H200 / RTX PRO 6000 server: the serving engine matters more than GPU count, bandwidth sets speed, and a 27B model on two GPUs serves 64 users at about 1 J per token.

entry.title: Redefining Research: When AI Does the Science, Who Becomes the Scientist?
entry.summary: AI can accelerate discovery. But if students delegate the work through which expertise is learned, who will recognize when machines are wrong?
